text:
maria_suarez: FYI - Customer (big GCP shop) asked for an annotated playbook for connecting Redwood Private via Interconnect / Partner Interconnect. They want e2e notes for egress, DNS, MTU, and firewall rules.

ajackson: Great — do they want Private Service Connect or Classic VPC peering?

maria_suarez: They prefer PSC for managed endpoint semantics but are open to a peering fallback if PSC can't meet their security policy. Also asked about how we preserve client source IPs for audit logging.

tyler_ops: For PSC we terminate on a PSC endpoint that forwards to our VPC. Source IP preservation: if you need original client IP, we recommend a NAT-less path (VPC peering) or use PROXY protocol at the proxy layer. PSC terminates TCP so client IPs will be our connector IPs unless we maintain a direct path.

nora_net: Adding some concrete network snippets. Proposed egress CIDR that customers need to allow: `35.200.0.0/16` (example for our egress NAT pool) — we'll provide the exact list in the final doc.

maria_suarez: They also asked about MTU mismatch over Interconnect — can cause packet fragmentation for large embeddings payloads. What's our guidance?

tyler_ops: Keep MTU at 1460 on the path (Interconnect reduces MTU due to VLAN encapsulation). Recommend customers set GRE/PTP endpoints to 1460 and enable TCP MSS clamping on on-prem firewalls.

nora_net: Quick firewall example they can paste:

```
# allow outbound to Redwood egress pool (example)
allow tcp from 10.0.0.0/16 to 35.200.0.0/16 ports 443
allow udp/icmp for healthchecks 10.0.0.0/16 to 35.200.0.0/16
# BGP and interconnect prep
allow tcp from their-edge-ip to 169.254.1.1? (if doing metadata helpers)
```

ajackson: Also include a snippet for PSC firewall rules and IAM roles (service attachment consumer config). They always miss the `roles/compute.networkUser` bit.

maria_suarez: Security questionnaire Q: "Can Redwood run inside our VPC or require traffic egress?" Answer: We support Private (customer-hosted) where Redwood runtime can sit inside customer-managed VPC (on-prem or VPC deployment) or Private Service Connect/peering for hosted flows. Will include options and tradeoffs.

infra_bot: [automated] Attachments: Sample CIDR list, PSC architecture diagram (v1), checklist.xlsx

tyler_ops: Pricing callout: if they use Interconnect with high egress, call out sustained egress pricing and any cross-connect fees on their side. For Reserved/Dedicated capacity customers, we can propose committed throughput pricing to offset egress variability.

maria_suarez: They asked about failover: multi-region interconnect + PSC fallback to peering. We should show routing policy: primary PSC endpoint in us-central1, fallback peering to us-east1. Include BGP priority and healthcheck doc.

nora_net: Healthcheck recommendations: 3 probes, 10s interval, fail after 3 misses. Use TCP/443 to our health endpoint `/hc/llm` (we'll expose per-account token).

ajackson: Action items:
- nora_net: produce annotated firewall + BGP snippet + MTU checklist (due EOD tomorrow)
- tyler_ops: write a short pricing blurb for Interconnect egress + reserved capacity options
- maria_suarez: consolidate into a single playbook and send to customer with an internal redline for legal/security answers

maria_suarez: I'll also request exact egress IP list from infra for the account (we rotate pools monthly; will pin for POC).

sales_ops: Customer timeline: wants POC in 2 weeks. Can we meet that if we pin an egress pool?

tyler_ops: Two weeks is tight but doable if we pin pool and pre-provision PSC endpoint. Need network contact from their side for BGP creds by EOD+3.

nora_net: Sample BGP config for them to copy (placeholder):

```
neighbor 203.0.113.10 remote-as 64512
neighbor 203.0.113.10 description redwood-interconnect
network 10.10.0.0/20
```

maria_suarez: Great. I'll draft the email and attach the playbook. Anyone want to review before I send?

ajackson: +1, will scan for PSC IAM bits.

tyler_ops: I'll proof the pricing section.

infra_bot: [automated] playbook-draft-v1 uploaded to /shared/sales/poc-playbooks/4791234567-playbook-draft.pdf

maria_suarez: Thanks team. I'll aim to send tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
